property_summary: For any recipient contract whose fallback/receive reverts, calling withdraw(amount) by the owner on the correct contract always reverts (so the call does not succeed), while the mutant using send may succeed (not revert) and thus violate the requirement that owner-initiated withdraw to a reverting recipient cannot silently succeed.
change_summary: Replace transfer to send (returns bool) and ignore revert on failure, changing whether withdraw actually reverts or not.
